name: DeepJudge
description: DeepJudge is the core AI platform for legal professionals to harness their institutional intelligence. Bring your organization's expertise, prior work, and accepted positions to your work in Claude, ensuring outputs are grounded in your knowledge, standards and judgment.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DeepJudge to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DeepJudge to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://anthropic.deepjudge.ai/api/tenants/d/mcp/anthropic. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DeepJudge MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DeepJudge provides these MCP tools: deepjudge_get_task_result, deepjudge_run_task, and resource_read.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DeepJudge?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DeepJudge in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
DeepJudge requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DeepJudge is developed by DeepJudge. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
